733520101.text: Why, my greetings to you, dear traveler from afar, and to your little friend. Have you been enjoying the Sabzeruz Festival?

733520102.text: If you're both interested, I, the Phantom Toy Master, shall be pleased to invite you to play a new game — the "Rocking Carriage," a flower that blooms only during the Festival.

733520104.text: Just hearing the name, Paimon's kinda imagining Nahida happily swaying from side to side in her carriage!

733520107.text: Wonderful! All in Sumeru wish that the "Dendro Archon shall be happy every day," after all.

733520108.text: That association you made... Ah, what an excellent scene! One that deserves to be rendered upon a magnificent scroll, if I do say so myself!

733520109.text: Still, the atmosphere of this game is a livelier thing. Rather than a celebration, it's best thought of as an adventure—

733520110.text: "Smart or not, nice or naughty, every child with a good heart will receive their own Flower Carriage during the Sabzeruz Festival celebrations..."

733520111.text: "Riding in their carriage, the children shall embark on unique adventures, encountering and overcoming danger, and finding the greatest treasure, a thousand blooming flowers..."
